reference.label: Phase-change-suppressed WALE reference
reference.pressure_conversion: Kinematic gauge pressure p_native times 1000 kg/m³ exactly once to Pa.
reference.comparison_note: Counterfactual phase-change-suppressed reference at low pressure, not a demonstrated noncavitating state. Solver and numerics differ; not an isolated validated cavitation-effect experiment.

pressure.title: Gauge flow pressure comparison (Pa)
pressure.description: Shared global gauge pressure scale [-5569.080078125, 5569.080078125] Pa. Reference = 1000*p once; new dimensional p minus 3500 Pa. Saturation = -1160.7 Pa gauge. FLOW, NOT ACOUSTIC WAVES.

velocity.title: Flow speed comparison (m/s)
velocity.description: Shared global speed scale [0.0, 2.673161035764044] m/s, magnitude of all three native U components. FLOW, NOT ACOUSTIC WAVES.

vapour.title: Native vapour fraction (0–1)
vapour.description: Native vapour fraction 1-alpha.water, dimensionless scale 0..1; raw floating tails retained, under/over colours indicated. Native holes and moving connectivity preserved. FLOW, NOT ACOUSTIC WAVES.

history_support: Vapour area (m²) = native vapour volume / 0.01 m numerical depth; per-row sum of native water and vapour integrals. No point averaging or pixel area. Vapour maximum, absolute-pressure minimum (Pa) and speed maximum (m/s) are sampled native z=0 plane point extrema, not whole-volume cell extrema. Alpha bound tolerance 1e-7; raw values retained without clipping. All output times retained; no resampling, causal-lag or steady-state inference.

limitations: Strict-2D WALE is not resolved 3D LES.
